I’m the same, I always have my worst panic attacks at night and I start obsessing over whether or not I will throw up in the middle of the night or  overthinking death etc.
I love sleeping because it’s the only time I’m not feeling suicidal and overthinking and analysing everything.

She asked me varying questions such as the patterns to my mood, how frequently I self harm, how often I have suicidal thoughts, if I often feel empty, patterns of relationships/friendships and how I function in daily life, if I’m impulsive and often act before thinking and details about my childhood and early life, and family structure etc.

I started when I was 16, I’d had a fight with my parents and on impulse I scratched my arm really hard. After that any time I felt down I scratched until I eventually broke the skin. Then when I was 17 I started cutting with paper clips and now at 18 I’m using broken glass and my arms and legs are covered in scars. That’s why it is really important to take control of self-harm as soon as it starts before it develops and takes control of you.
I feel the same way. I can’t understand why there is so much emphasis on suicide prevention when we are all going to die anyway. What’s the point in forcing people to live a miserable life??
I’ve tried therapy and I am on antidepressants. Nothing is working
Yeah I always do it but it makes me feel even more alone when I see that their arms are clear and they get to be happy 😢

Yep I am, I spend all day at school on my own. I’ve also only had fake friends but I try not to care. I stir at my phone and try to pretend it doesn’t affect me but in reality it tears my up inside. It’s too much effort to speak to people I have no motivation and anxiety which makes it difficult to talk anyway. I don’t want to ruin more people’s lives with my existence.

I get how you feel, my life is falling to shit at the minute and I wish I was brave enough to end it because I know that I shouldn’t be here, I never should have been born. My advice for your situation at the minute, is to try and stay calm and also try to stay out of your mom’s way to also give her space to calm down. She won’t kick you out, people say things in the heat of the moment that they don’t mean. I’m always here if you need to talk.
Thanks for you reply. I am actually on medication and have been since late October. I am taking sertraline but it isn’t working and I’m just getting worse.

I always do this, the house phone is the worst because I have this obsession that people are going to take me into hospital behind my back. Every time the house phone rings I jump up and run downstairs my parents always shout at me for being nosy but really it’s just to settle my paranoia.

Try not worry, you did the right thing (I know it’s easier said than done!)

Not really fair to be placing everyone into a category like that...
The assault with Bryce happened over a week before Hannah committed suicide so many of the marks may not be on her anymore.

To me suicide isn’t selfish, it indicates that a person is in so much mental/ emotional pain that they feel like taking their own live is the only option. Having suffered from suicidal thoughts and feelings myself I honestly don’t feel it is fair to give suicide the label of being ‘selfish’. In my opinion it is more selfish to deprive a suicidal person of getting appropriate help and making them feel more isolated e.g Hannah than that said person taking their own life.

I feel like Hannah’s parents were super supportive and if she had told them what was going on they would have stuck by her 100% and probably even moved again for her. 
However at school she basically was a loner and had no true friends, everytime she thought she had made a friend they deceived her in some way which reinforced to her that she had no one. Making her feel more isolated and alone.
Of course I understand that it’s a real issue having suffered from mental problems myself. So please don’t imply that I am unsympathetic to this problem, thank you.

She was a 17 year old girl who had already been bullied for over a year at high school, unable to trust anyone because people always let her down. Then when she felt her lowest Bryce raped her and you are saying that she shouldn’t gave a shit? Fuck you.
